questions.question: Which thalamic nucleus acts as the sensory relay station for visual impulses from both retina to the visual cortex?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A. Lateral geniculate body

questions.question: The Ishihara test is primarily used to assess which of the following?
Which ganglion cell is responsible for Rod vision?
X ganglion cells responsible for color vision end in which neurons in the Lateral geniculate body of the thalamus?
In the visual pathway, fibers from the nasal halves of the retinas:
options: Remain uncrossed and join the ipsilateral optic tract
Cross at the optic chiasma to the opposite side
Terminate in the medial geniculate body
Carry impulses only from the nasal visual field
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. Cross at the optic chiasma to the opposite side

questions.question: The secondary visual cortex (areas 18 and 19) is responsible for which of the following?
options: Understanding the meaning of visual images and words
Transmission of visual impulses from retina
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. Understanding the meaning of visual images and words

questions.question: The primary visual cortex (area 17) is responsible for which of the following?
options: Understanding the meaning of visual images and words
Transmission of visual impulses from retina
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A. Perception of raw visual sensations

questions.question: A patient looks at an object situated in the nasal visual field. The image is projected onto which retinal region?
options: The nasal half of the retina
The temporal half of the retina
The upper half of the retina
The lower half of the retina
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. The temporal half of the retina

questions.question: Which of the following explains positive after image phenomenon?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C. Reverberating circuits of the retinal

questions.question: Blindness of the opposite half of the visual field of both eyes caused by destruction of which of the following cortical area?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A. Primary visual cortex (area 17)
